text.p: Typhoon Opal is over southern Honshu, Japan, moving northeast at 22 mph. Top winds are 75 mph. Opal is rapidly weakening and losing tropical characteristics as it passes over Honshu. It will turn east northeastward and move out to sea east of Japan during the next 24 hours. Wind damage is likely during the next several hours, then winds will become less of a problem as the storm weakens. Heavy rainfall will likely lead to flash flooding and mudslides over the mountains terrain of Honshu. Opal is also a threat to shipping along the coast of Japan.
There are no further statements at this time.
